hook: orphan 否定團來櫃台蓋章：unexceptionable／irreproachable／irreconcilable／indiscriminate——橡皮擦比印章還大。
script: unexceptionable／irreproachable 無可指摘。irreconcilable 不可調和。indiscriminate 不加分別。incommensurate 不成比例。口令：橡皮寫「不是全刪」，印章寫「精準否定」。

members.senseAnchor: completely acceptable; not open to exception or reproach
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 完美章: unexceptionable walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「完美章」出場：unexceptionable 一上場梗就黏住——無可指摘的。

members.senseAnchor: free of guilt; not subject to blame
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 無瑕章: irreproachable walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「無瑕章」出場：irreproachable 一上場梗就黏住——無可指責的。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 裂痕章: irreconcilable walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「裂痕章」出場：irreconcilable 一上場梗就黏住——不可調和的。

members.senseAnchor: failing to make or recognize distinctions; not marked by fine distinctions
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 亂灑章: indiscriminate walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「亂灑章」出場：indiscriminate 一上場梗就黏住——不加分別的。

members.senseAnchor: not corresponding in size or degree or extent
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 比例歪: incommensurate walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「比例歪」出場：incommensurate 一上場梗就黏住——不成比例的。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 無濾鏡: undiscriminating walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「無濾鏡」出場：undiscriminating 一上場梗就黏住——無辨別的。

members.senseAnchor: not prepared or planned in advance; not premeditated
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 臨時章: unpremeditated walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「臨時章」出場：unpremeditated 一上場梗就黏住——非預謀的。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 單線: unidimensional walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「單線」出場：unidimensional 一上場梗就黏住——單向度的。

members.senseAnchor: despite anything to the contrary (usually following a concession)
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 轉折橋: notwithstanding walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「轉折橋」出場：notwithstanding 一上場梗就黏住——儘管。

related.synonyms: however, nevertheless, withal, still, yet, nonetheless
related.antonyms: agitate, louden, moving, no longer, sparkling

members.senseAnchor: contrary to what common sense would suggest
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 反常識: counterintuitive walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「反常識」出場：counterintuitive 一上場梗就黏住——反直覺的。

members.senseAnchor: too large or too small when compared with something else
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 失衡秤: disproportionate walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「失衡秤」出場：disproportionate 一上場梗就黏住——不成比例的。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 橡皮擦: eraser walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「橡皮擦」出場：eraser 一上場梗就黏住——橡皮擦。
